RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

The all-male panel is weak evidence on its own — it reflects the demographics of senior engineering, so it's nearly the default in your sector. It matters as context, not as proof, and leading with it lets them dismiss you as reading tea leaves.

The stronger facts are the ones you can document: nearly double the relevant experience, three major projects led, and a vague tiebreaker ("excellent client relationships") that was never defined as a criterion in the advertisement. The unanswered two-week request is also a legitimate complaint in itself.

So: chase the written reasons firmly, in writing, with a deadline. Ask what criteria were weighted and how each candidate scored. Mention panel composition only once you see whether the reasoning holds up.
